findings.text: _held_reads compares Path(os.environ.get(...)) with self.source_root, which run() derives from dict(os.environ), so the two are identical whenever run() constructs the reloader and the flag is a constant True; the named-root branch at :399 is unreachable and the comment at :364-367 says the post-reload read is answered from the tree rather than held when it is in fact held.

the mid-start deferral is part of the plan's Deliverable but no assertion fails if _children_mid_start is deleted, because a child survives an exec and is re-adopted from the handover or the census, so the gate cannot catch a regression there.

the pid-start-time refinement that refuses a reused pid is untested; no case exercises a mismatched pid_start, so the guard that stops the replacement supervising a stranger is exercised only on the passing path.

StationReloader is the repository's owner of replacing a long-running crew process with a proved image from the runtime root, and the new _HostReloader duplicates that orchestration instead of extending or wrapping it.
